about: Feel the heat of battle in an adrenaline-fueled journey full of intense combat and tactical teamwork.
• Make every shot count as you target the enemy with deadly precision using the PlayStation®VR Aim Controller.
• Step into an urban war zone and experience every explosion in intense guerrilla firefights behind enemy lines.
• Experience the sensation of battle and plan strategic manoeuvres as a unit to gain the advantage.
• Snatch victory from the jaws of defeat as you adapt your tactics, with each weapon presenting new opportunities for combat.
Network Players 2-2 - Full game requires PlayStation®Plus membership to access online multiplayer
PlayStation®VR and PlayStation®Camera is required to play this product
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation Network is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
summary: Feel the heat of battle in an adrenaline-fueled journey full of intense combat and tactical teamwork.
